offerings.name: Tavily Search
offerings.pricing: Free: 1,000 credits/month；Pay-as-you-go: $0.008 per credit；Monthly plans: $0.0075 - $0.005 per credit；Enterprise: Custom pricing and volume。Basic Search 每次请求 1 API credit，Advanced Search 每次请求 2 API credits
offerings.free_quota: You get 1,000 free API Credits every month. No credit card required.
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（可选 LLM 生成答案）
offerings.note: search_depth: basic/fast/ultra-fast 1 credit，advanced 2 credits；max_results 0-20（默认10）；chunks_per_source 1-3；支持 general/news/finance topic、域名过滤、国家/语言 boost；auto_parameters 可能自动用 advanced（2 credits）。月付档：Project 4,000 credits $30 / Bootstrap 15,000 $100 / Startup 38,000 $220 / Growth 100,000 $500

offerings.name: Tavily Research
offerings.pricing: 动态定价模型，每次请求有最低/最高 credit 消耗边界：model=pro 15-250 credits/次；model=mini 4-110 credits/次
offerings.price_basis: 动态定价（按 credit 计费，边界随 model=pro/mini 不同）
offerings.output_type: 研究任务（异步，支持流式）
offerings.note: Request Cost Boundaries: model=pro 每次最低 15、最高 250 credits；model=mini 每次最低 4、最高 110 credits。credit 单价同套餐（PAYG $0.008/credit）
